title: LOOP_V1 frontier-call ledger row
description: One row of run_state/frontier_calls.jsonl, appended by agent_wrapper.frontier_cli.invoke_frontier BEFORE every return (real, mock, and every error path). The original eight fields remain required for old immutable rows. New rows also record an optional resolved binary path and closed failure code; verdict remains null at this layer (the review layer owns verdicts). candidate_id and reasoning_digest are optional review-layer fields. Append-only ledger; rows are never edited.

timestamp.description: UTC ISO 8601 with trailing Z, e.g. 2026-08-14T12:00:00.000000Z.

cli_version.description: Output of the selected `<cli> --version` (memoized by resolved binary path); 'unknown' when the probe fails; 'mock' under MOCK_LLM.

resolved_binary_path.description: Real path of the selected executable on new rows; null when absent or under MOCK_LLM. Optional for old immutable rows. An invalid explicit pin stays authoritative and records its attempted path.

failure_code.description: Closed non-secret error category on new rows; null on success/mock. Optional for old immutable rows. Raw stderr and CLI response text are never written to the ledger.

role.description: Caller-declared role for the call, e.g. methods_reviewer / novelty_reviewer.

candidate_id.description: Join key vs the local (Qwen) vote fields for the frontier-vs-local calibration dataset (LOOP_V1 P2). Review-layer field; frontier_cli does not write it.

verdict.description: Always null at the frontier_cli layer -- the review layer owns verdicts.

reasoning_digest.description: Short digest of the reviewer's reasoning (LOOP_V1 P2). Review-layer field; frontier_cli does not write it.

duration_ms.description: Wall-clock milliseconds for the call; 0 under MOCK_LLM.

exit_code.description: CLI process exit code; -1 on timeout, 127 on launch failure, 0 under MOCK_LLM.

prompt_sha256.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the exact prompt string (the prompt itself is never logged).
